title.zh: 在世界的货源地，造一处安静的停顿
title.en: A quiet pause at the world's marketplace

paragraphs.zh: 义乌，世界小商品之都，一座每小时都有货物流转的城市。蔚印象选择在这里，不是为了速度，而是为了停顿——为奔波而来的旅人，留一处可以慢下来的空间。
paragraphs.en: Yiwu moves fast — goods flow through its markets every hour of every day. Wei Impression was conceived not for speed, but as a pause: a place where travellers can finally slow down.

paragraphs.zh: 我们相信，真正高级的酒店不制造噪音。它用留白说话，用光影呼吸，用木与石的触感让人安定下来。
paragraphs.en: We believe a truly refined hotel makes no noise. It speaks through restraint, breathes through light and shadow, and settles the mind with the touch of wood and stone.

title.en: Less is more. Quiet is the new luxury.

paragraphs.zh: 设计不是装饰，而是氛围。蔚印象以米白与暖灰为底，让木材、石材、织物与植物各自安放；光线经过格栅与窗纱的过滤，在墙面留下缓慢移动的影子。
paragraphs.en: Design here is atmosphere, not decoration. Warm whites and soft greys give wood, stone, linen and green their own place; light passes through lattice and sheer curtains, leaving slow shadows on the walls.

paragraphs.zh: 每一处细节都经过克制地取舍——不摆多余的器物，不设喧嚣的灯光。留给你的，是空间本身。
paragraphs.en: Every object is a deliberate subtraction. Nothing excessive, nothing loud — the space is left to you.

title.zh: 服务是隐形的，需求是提前被想到的
title.en: Service should be invisible — needs anticipated, never announced

paragraphs.zh: 我们不追求标准化的微笑，而追求恰到好处的在场。前台 24 小时亮着灯，但你几乎感觉不到它的存在——直到你需要它。
paragraphs.en: We do not chase standardized smiles. The front desk is lit around the clock, yet nearly invisible — until the moment you need it.

paragraphs.zh: 入住无需排队，问题无需等待。这座城市很忙，我们把安静留给你。
paragraphs.en: Check-in without queues. Answers without waiting. The city is busy enough — we keep the quiet for you.

text.zh: 无感办理，快速入住；语音与 AI 助手随时应答，像有一位不打扰你的管家。
text.en: Touchless check-in and an AI concierge that answers quietly — like a butler who never interrupts.

text.zh: 遮光织物、静音环境与助眠香氛，把睡眠当作一项工程来完成。
text.en: Blackout fabrics, silent rooms and calming scents — sleep treated as a craft.

text.zh: 从国际商贸城到老街巷，为每一位客人定制一条属于自己的义乌路线。
text.en: From the international market to hidden alleys — a personal Yiwu route for every guest.
